originalConflict.detail: Owner approved proposal on 2026-10-14 (làm theo đề xuất). Separate adoption for 母倉; P4-B authority unchanged. S1 onset/後/定氣 remains OPEN.
卷五 explicit 巳午 twice and 不用干而用支; 卷十 raw and scan commentary 己午 retained verbatim; use definition 巳午, not mixed stem/branch.
卷十 raw/scan 月恩; 卷十一 raw/scan 月德. Preserve both; no warehouse predicate selected.
Raw 卷十一 uses 福徳 while scan and definition show 福德; equivalent name at same heading positions, retain raw quote and normalize token only.
卷四 introductory 四利三元 收為福德 differs from reviewed monthly 福德/滿. Do not reuse it, 天巫, generic 福德 or personal-star labels as aliases.
Locked raw 卷五 prints 巳 in stem 己 positions (巳卯,巳酉 and explanatory 巳土). Scan pages 38–40 explicitly 己. Preserve raw bytes; adopted pillar list uses 己, not illegal 巳卯/巳酉.
六十甲子首五日 and two midpoint five-day ranges, plus 不參諸月令; never lunar days 1–5/16–20 or Month Jian lookup.
Definition quotation retained; adopted heading scope follows 卷十 又為天巫宜祭祀祈福 and 卷十一 matching heading lists, not 合藥請醫.
Quoted older 天狗常居月建前二辰 is narrowed by editor to 申建戌日 only; not all 滿日 and not a 天巫 alias.
滿日/福德 have same position, separate authority/use scopes. No aliases adopted.
Source says 天后與驛馬同位/天后者驛馬也. P4-C keeps two named operands with same position and different named 宜; no alias merges travel/moving into medical or vice versa.
Main rule and chart are monthly; year/day variants remain documented outside coverage, not new required inputs.
卷十 raw anchor 乂為天醫宜求醫療病, scan PDF117 又為天醫宜求醫療病. Keep raw and record scan separately; no new god alias.
成日/天喜 share position but own headings; do not alias either to 天醫 or inherit their 宜.
Read full editorial paragraph; monthly 天醫 rule is explicit and unchanged by adjacent 天喜 alternatives.
義同除日 describes usage, not presence equality: 除日 monthly offset +1, 除神 fixed 申/酉; 卷十一 lists both.
五離 same day positions, distinct named 宜/忌. No token alias adopted.
Existing tru_than han=除神, dayChi=[8,9], medical/cleaning/cut_hair match independently reviewed source.
Raw 宜沐浴祓除災眚; scan PDF117 宜沐浴祓除災害. Preserve both wordings, no predicate change.
天后與驛馬同位 and explanatory 天后者驛馬也 do not merge P4-C tokens; 天后 medical use distinct from 驛馬 travel/moving.

Definition quotes older court and military uses; 卷十 explicitly limits direct uses and makes court uses conditional.
Shared 除/吉期/兵寶 chart and position do not authorize merging god token identities or medical/bathing/military heading scopes.
卷四 older military/marriage quotation preserved; 卷十 editor reassigns military use to 兵寶 and rejects marriage use.
卷十一 raw 詔命公{{SKchar|2721}}招賢 preserved byte-for-byte; scan shows 詔命公卿招賢. Normalized heading only, not a god alias.
Older quoted list has 庚寅/壬寅 and omits 甲午; corrected 立成 removes those two and includes 甲午, 13 days. Preserve both quotations, adopt final editor.
Final editor raw has 乙丁巳辛癸/巳為隂土; scan PDF138–139 reads 己 in both positions, and raw/scan 立成 includes 己酉. Raw bytes remain unchanged; predicate adopts day stem 己.
鳴吠對 has corrected 11-day set and separate 啓攢 usage; not an alias or automatic six-branch opposition of the 13-day set.
戌者指葬地而非指葬日; 金雞鳴玉犬吠 explanatory phrase does not authorize 戌 days or accepted alias.
